propositions: Live DC harness must render pushed rich-text bodies as HTML via ?expand=renderedFields and assert expected markup (headings, bold, code macros) to prove codec fidelity against Jira's real DC renderer
State-based echo-safety requires a second reconcile pass to detect no inbound description mutation when Jira echoes back the landed rich-text wire form, preventing spurious re-pushes

Under both-sides concurrent edits (local AND remote diverge from baseline) before a reconcile pass, the system must emit rebar's body (local-wins), record the remote value via bridge alert, and never silently clobber the remote
InboundMapper.normalize_rich_text must maintain a stable public contract (signature and type/shape) so breaking changes to the seam fail in the contract test before impacting agentic-dev-platform

The inbound differ must apply codec-aware echo-suppression for rich-text descriptions by comparing Jira's echoed value against the local body's landed wire form (map_fields_to_remote), mirroring the outbound _baseline_form_matches guard

DC rich-text cutover must be explicitly enabled (REBAR_RECONCILER_RICH_TEXT_CUTOVER=dc) in the live test harness for WikiTextCodec to perform Markdown→wiki conversion (# heading→h1., **bold**→*bold*, {code} macros)
